record.name: CatalogItemState
record.summary: Current catalog identity and pending-delete state for an item instance.

property.name: ItemInstanceToken
property.summary: Non-empty token identifying this continuous item instance.

property.name: IsPendingDelete
property.summary: Indicates whether deletion has begun and the item is hidden from normal catalog access.

constructor.name: CatalogItemState
constructor.summary: Creates a catalog item state from its identity and deletion status.
constructor.param: Catalog item identifier; must not be empty.
Item instance token; must not be empty.
